The residue of $52$ modulo $5$ is the integer $0\le r<5$ such that

$$
52≡r\,(\text{mod}\,5).
$$

**Method 1**

To find the residue $r,$ we need to write $52$ as an integer multiple of $5,$ plus the residue $r.$

We note that $52≡2\,(\text{mod}\,5)$ because

$$
52=10\cdot 5+2.
$$

Therefore, the residue of $52$ modulo $5$ is $2.$

**Method 2**

We can use the subtraction property:

$$
\begin{aligned}52 & ≡52-0 &  & (\text{mod}\,5) \\  & ≡52-10\cdot 5 &  & (\text{mod}\,5) \\  & ≡52-50 &  & (\text{mod}\,5) \\  & ≡2 &  & (\text{mod}\,5)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the residue of $52$ modulo $5$ is $2.$
